title: A second submit against an already-leased operator is rejected (single-flight)
notes: GREEN: an active lease is acquired first, so the operator is 'leased' and submit() rejects the duplicate (operator_runtime.py:474 via get_operator_runtime_state -> 'leased'; acquire_operator_lease also rejects a live duplicate at :215). RED: skip_pre_lease removes the first lease -> submit succeeds -> submit_ok=true fails the expect.
